event.12V_LOW: 12V battery source below required voltage to safely close contactors. Inspect the supply/battery!
event.AUTOMATIC_PRECHARGE_FAILURE: Automatic precharge FAILURE. Failed to reach target voltage or BMS timeout. Reboot emulator to retry!
event.BATTERY_CAUTION: Battery has raised a general caution flag. Might want to inspect it closely.
event.BATTERY_CHG_DISCHG_STOP_REQ: Battery raised caution indicator AND requested charge/discharge stop. Inspect battery status!
event.BATTERY_CHG_STOP_REQ: Battery raised caution indicator AND requested charge stop. Inspect battery status!
event.BATTERY_CONFIG_INVALID: An extra battery is configured while the primary battery slot is empty. The system reports the primary slot's values, so it cannot run this way. Configure the primary battery, then reboot.
event.BATTERY_DISCHG_STOP_REQ: Battery raised caution indicator AND requested discharge stop. Inspect battery status!
event.BATTERY_FROZEN: Battery is too cold to operate optimally. Consider warming it up!
event.BATTERY_FUSE: Battery internal fuse blown. Inspect battery
event.BATTERY_INTERFACE_UNSUPPORTED: Battery not started: the selected battery type needs a bus the assigned interface does not provide. Assign a suitable interface, or select a battery type this hardware supports.
event.BATTERY_ISOLATION: Battery reports isolation error. High voltage might be leaking to ground. Check battery!
event.BATTERY_OVERHEAT: Battery overheated. Shutting down to prevent thermal runaway!
event.BATTERY_OVERVOLTAGE: Battery exceeding maximum design voltage. Discharge battery to prevent damage!
event.BATTERY_REQUESTS_HEAT: COLD BATTERY! Battery requesting heating pads to activate!
event.BATTERY_SLOT_UNSUPPORTED: Extra battery not started: the selected battery type does not support multiple packs.
event.BATTERY_SOC_RECALIBRATION: The BMS updated the HV battery State of Charge (SOC) by more than 3pct based on SocByOcv.
event.BATTERY_SOC_RESET_FAIL: SOC reset routine failed - check SOC is < 15 or > 90, and contactors are open.
event.BATTERY_TEMP_DEVIATION_HIGH: Large temperature deviation between battery sensors! Check cooling and sensor wiring
event.BATTERY_UNDERVOLTAGE: Battery under minimum design voltage. Charge battery to prevent damage!
event.BATTERY_VALUE_UNAVAILABLE: Battery measurement unavailable. Check 12V power supply and battery wiring!
event.BATTERY_WARMED_UP: Battery requesting heating pads to stop. The battery is now warm enough.
event.BMS_RESET_REQ_FAIL: BMS reset request failed - check contactors are open.
event.BYD_AUTO_SOC_CALIBRATION: Auto SOC recalibration to 100% triggered. Data column shows drift% below 100%.
event.BYD_CONTACTOR_CLOSE_REQ: Contactor close commanded. The battery precharges and closes its contactors. Data: 1 = cancelled a pending open.
event.BYD_CONTACTOR_FORCE_OPEN: Contactors force-opened: pack current was not confirmed safe before the timeout. Data: 0 = current stayed high, 1 = no fresh current reading. Check the inverter ramped down.
event.BYD_CONTACTOR_MISMATCH: Battery did not confirm the contactor command in time. Data: 2 = open not confirmed, 3 = close not confirmed.
event.BYD_CONTACTOR_OPEN_REQ: Contactor open commanded. Power is set to zero and the contactors open once current stops. Data: 1 = from an emergency stop saved across reboot.
event.CANFD_2_BUFFER_FULL: CAN failed to send. Buffer full or no one on the bus to ACK the message!
event.CANFD_2_BUS_ERROR: Multiple CAN TX/RX errors. Check wiring!
event.CANFD_BUFFER_FULL: CAN failed to send. Buffer full or no one on the bus to ACK the message!
event.CANFD_BUS_ERROR: Multiple CAN TX/RX errors. Check wiring!
event.CANMCP2515_BUFFER_FULL: CAN failed to send. Buffer full or no one on the bus to ACK the message!
event.CANMCP2515_BUS_ERROR: Multiple CAN TX/RX errors. Check wiring!
event.CANMCP2515_INIT_FAILURE: CAN-MCP addon initialization failed. Check hardware
event.CANMCP2518FD_INIT_FAILURE: CAN-FD initialization failed. Check hardware or bitrate settings
event.CAN_BATTERY2_DETECTED: Successfully communicating with secondary battery. Secondary battery detected!
event.CAN_BATTERY2_MISSING: Secondary battery not sending messages via CAN for the last 60 seconds. Check wiring!
event.CAN_BATTERY3_DETECTED: Successfully communicating with third battery. Third battery detected!
event.CAN_BATTERY3_MISSING: Third battery not sending messages via CAN for the last 60 seconds. Check wiring!
event.CAN_BATTERY_DETECTED: Successfully communicating with battery. Battery detected!
event.CAN_BATTERY_MISSING: Battery not sending messages via CAN for the last 60 seconds. Check wiring!
event.CAN_CHARGER_DETECTED: Successfully communicating with charger. Charger detected!
event.CAN_CHARGER_MISSING: Charger not sending messages via CAN for the last 60 seconds. Check wiring!
event.CAN_CONFIG_INVALID: A CAN interface was not started: the devices assigned to it need incompatible bus speeds, or more than one battery shares it. Give each battery its own interface and matching speeds, then reboot.
event.CAN_CORRUPTED_WARNING: High amount of corrupted CAN messages detected. Check CAN wire shielding!
event.CAN_INVERTER_DETECTED: Successfully communicating with inverter. Inverter detected!
event.CAN_INVERTER_MISSING: Inverter not sending messages via CAN for the last 60 seconds. Check wiring!
event.CAN_NATIVE_BUFFER_FULL: CAN failed to send. Buffer full or no one on the bus to ACK the message!
event.CAN_NATIVE_BUS_ERROR: Multiple CAN TX/RX errors. Check wiring!
event.CELL_CRITICAL_OVER_VOLTAGE: CELL VOLTAGE CRITICALLY HIGH! Not possible to continue. Inspect battery!
event.CELL_CRITICAL_UNDER_VOLTAGE: CELL VOLTAGE CRITICALLY LOW! Not possible to continue. Inspect battery!
event.CELL_DEVIATION_HIGH: Large cell voltage deviation! Check balancing of cells
event.CELL_OVER_VOLTAGE: Cell overvoltage. Further charging not possible. Check balancing of cells
event.CELL_UNDER_VOLTAGE: Cell undervoltage. Further discharge not possible. Check balancing of cells
event.CHARGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Inverter is charging faster than battery is allowing.
event.CONTACTOR_OPEN: Battery decided to open contactors. Inspect battery!
event.CONTACTOR_WELDED: Contactors sticking/welded. Inspect battery with caution!
event.DISCHARGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Inverter is discharging faster than battery is allowing.
event.DUMMY_DEBUG: The dummy debug event was set!
event.DUMMY_ERROR: The dummy error event was set!
event.DUMMY_INFO: The dummy info event was set!
event.DUMMY_WARNING: The dummy warning event was set!
event.EQUIPMENT_STOP: User requested stop, either via equipment stop circuit or webserver Open Contactor button
event.ERROR_OPEN_CONTACTOR: Too much time spent in error state. Opening contactors, not safe to continue. Check other active ERROR code for reason. Reboot emulator after problem is solved!
event.GPIO_CONFLICT: IO expander initialization failed. CAN transceivers and bus termination are inoperative. Check hardware.
event.GPIO_NOT_DEFINED: IO expander initialization failed. CAN transceivers and bus termination are inoperative. Check hardware.
event.HVIL_FAILURE: Battery interlock loop broken. Check that high voltage / low voltage connectors are seated. Battery will be disabled!
event.INTERFACE_MISSING: Configuration trying to use CAN interface not baked into the software. Recompile software!
event.INTERNAL_OPEN_FAULT: High voltage cable removed while battery running. Opening contactors!
event.INVERTER_OPEN_CONTACTOR: Inverter side opened contactors. Normal operation.
event.IOEXPANDER_INIT_FAILURE: IO expander initialization failed. CAN transceivers and bus termination are inoperative. Check hardware.
event.KWH_PLAUSIBILITY_ERROR: kWh remaining reported by battery not plausible. Battery needs cycling.
event.LOAD_SWITCH_FAULT: Load switch reports a hardware fault on a contactor output. Investigate wiring and load before reboot.
event.LOAD_SWITCH_INIT_FAILURE: Load switch initialisation failed. Load switch outputs are disabled for this session. Check hardware.
event.LOAD_SWITCH_ROLE_CONFLICT: Duplicate load switch role: this channel runs as Disabled. First channel with the role wins.
event.MODBUS_INVERTER_DETECTED: Successfully communicating with inverter over Modbus/RS485. Inverter detected!
event.MODBUS_INVERTER_MISSING: Modbus inverter has not sent any data. Inspect communication wiring!
event.NO_ENABLE_DETECTED: Inverter Enable line has not been active for a long time. Check Wiring!
event.PAUSE_BEGIN: The emulator is trying to pause the battery.
event.PAUSE_END: The emulator is attempting to resume battery operation from pause.
event.PERIODIC_BMS_RESET_FAILURE: BMS reset aborted - contactors were still under load.
event.PERSISTENT_SAVE_INFO: Failed to save user settings. Namespace full?
event.PID_FAILED: Failed to write PID request to battery
event.PRECHARGE_FAILURE: Battery failed to precharge. Check that capacitor is seated on high voltage output.
event.RECOVERY_END: Emergency charge recovery max time reached. Reboot and inspect if battery is able to continue normally
event.RECOVERY_START: CAUTION! Emergency low charge recovery started! Make sure battery cells do not overheat!
event.RESET_BROWNOUT: The board was reset due to a momentary low voltage condition. This is expected during certain operations like flashing via USB
event.RESET_CPU_LOCKUP: The board was reset due to CPU lockup. Inform developers!
event.RESET_DEEPSLEEP: The board was reset after exiting deep sleep mode
event.RESET_EFUSE: The board was reset due to an efuse error
event.RESET_EXT: The board was reset from an external pin
event.RESET_INT_WDT: The board was reset due to an interrupt watchdog timeout. Inform developers!
event.RESET_JTAG: The board was reset by JTAG
event.RESET_PANIC: The board was reset due to an exception or panic. Inform developers!
event.RESET_POWERON: The board was reset from a power-on event. Normal operation
event.RESET_PWR_GLITCH: The board was reset due to a detected power glitch
event.RESET_SDIO: The board was reset over SDIO
event.RESET_SW: The board was reset via software, webserver or OTA. Normal operation
event.RESET_TASK_WDT: The board was reset due to a task watchdog timeout. Inform developers!
event.RESET_UNKNOWN: The board was reset unexpectedly, and reason can't be determined
event.RESET_USB: The board was reset by the USB peripheral
event.RESET_WDT: The board was reset due to other watchdog timeout. Inform developers!
event.RJXZS_LOG: Error code active in RJXZS BMS. Clear via their smartphone app!
event.SD_INIT_FAILED: SD card initialization failed, check hardware. Power must be removed to reset the SD card.
event.SERIAL_RX_FAILURE: Error in serial function: No data for a long time!
event.SERIAL_RX_WARNING: Error in serial function: No data received for some time, see data for minutes
event.SERIAL_TRANSMITTER_FAILURE: Error in serial function: Some ERROR level fault in transmitter, received by receiver
event.SERIAL_TX_FAILURE: Error in serial function: No ACK from receiver!
event.SMA_PAIRING: SMA inverter trying to pair, contactors will close and open according to Enable line
event.SOC_PLAUSIBILITY_ERROR: SOC reported by battery not plausible. Restart battery!
event.SOC_UNAVAILABLE: SOC not sent by BMS. Calibrate BMS via app.
event.SOH_DIFFERENCE: Large deviation in State of health between packs. Inspect battery.
event.SOH_LOW: State of health critically low. Battery internal resistance too high to continue. Recycle battery.
event.STALE_VALUE: Important values detected as stale. System might have locked up!
event.TASK_OVERRUN: Task took too long to complete. CPU load might be too high. Info message, no action required.
event.THERMAL_RUNAWAY: THERMAL RUNAWAY! POTENTIAL FIRE OR EXPLOSION IMMINENT!
event.UNKNOWN_EVENT_SET: An unknown event was set! Review your code!
event.VOLTAGE_DIFFERENCE_BAT2: Too large voltage diff between the batteries. Second battery cannot join the DC-link
event.VOLTAGE_DIFFERENCE_BAT3: Too large voltage diff between the batteries. Third battery cannot join the DC-link
event.WATER_INGRESS: Water leakage inside battery detected. Operation halted. Inspect battery!
event.WIFI_AP_PASSWORD_DEFAULT: The AP will be disabled after 5 idle minutes. Change default password to keep AP constantly on!
event.WIFI_AP_PROVISION_TIMEOUT: Wi-Fi AP disabled due to cybersecurity concern. Change default password to keep AP constantly on! Reboot/Hold BOOT button 5-15 seconds to re-enable AP temporarily.
help.ESPNOWENABLED: Send battery telemetry to nearby devices over ESP-NOW
help.ESPNOWMACS: Comma separated list of receiver MAC addresses, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, 11:22:33:44:55:66 (max 8). Leave empty to broadcast to every device. Takes effect after a restart.
help.HADISC: Publish the discovery configs once after the next restart. Clears itself once they have been published.
help.HADISCFWU: Publish the discovery configs once after every firmware update. They carry the software version and can gain or change entities between releases.
help.HADISCTOPIC: MQTT auto discovery base topic (letters, numbers, '_', '-')
